title: What's next for Emdash
summary: Emdash 2.0 is on the way. Early access is open.
body_markdown:
We're building Emdash 2.0: coding agents for your whole team. We'll share more soon.


The current desktop app is now called Emdash Classic. It stays open source and keeps getting fixes.[Download Emdash Classic](https://emdash.com/download)
